ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Both figures show the same n-channel MOSFET circuit, with the MOSFET labeled M or M1; the source is grounded, the top node is labeled V_B, and there is a current I_D flowing downward into this node. This top node is simultaneously connected to the drain of the MOSFET, and is connected to the gate through the left-side wire, so this is a diode-connected NMOS with the gate and drain shorted. Reasoning: The source is grounded, so at the bias point V_B = 2 V, V_GS = V_B = 2 V, and V_DS = V_B = 2 V. The threshold voltage V_TN = 1 V, so the overdrive voltage V_OV = V_GS - V_TN = 2 - 1 = 1 V. Because V_DS = 2 V >= V_OV = 1 V, the MOSFET operates in the saturation region. When channel-length modulation is ignored, g_ds = 0. The saturation-region transconductance g_m = k_N V_OV = 40 μA/V^2 × 1 V = 40 μS. The small-signal resistance of the diode-connected MOSFET is dV_B/dI_D = 1/(g_m + g_ds) = 1/40 μS = 25 kΩ.

method.method_draft: Identify from the image that the MOSFET is diode-connected with source at ground, hence V_GS = V_DS = V_B. At V_B = 2 V, compute overdrive V_OV = V_GS - V_TN = 2 - 1 = 1 V. Confirm saturation because V_DS = 2 V >= V_OV = 1 V. Compute g_m = k_N V_OV = 40 microA/V^2 * 1 V = 40 microS. With g_ds = 0, dV_B/dI_D = 1/g_m = 25 kOhm.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：两张图都显示同一个 n 沟道 MOSFET 电路，MOSFET 标为 M 或 M1；源极接地，顶部节点标为 V_B，并有电流 I_D 向下流入该节点。该顶部节点同时连接到 MOSFET 的漏极，并通过左侧连线连接到栅极，因此这是一个栅漏短接的二极管连接 NMOS。

推理：源极接地，所以在偏置点 V_B = 2 V 时，V_GS = V_B = 2 V，且 V_DS = V_B = 2 V。阈值电压 V_TN = 1 V，因此过驱动电压 V_OV = V_GS - V_TN = 2 - 1 = 1 V。因为 V_DS = 2 V >= V_OV = 1 V，MOSFET 工作在饱和区。忽略沟道长度调制时 g_ds = 0。饱和区跨导 g_m = k_N V_OV = 40 μA/V^2 × 1 V = 40 μS。二极管连接 MOSFET 的小信号电阻为 dV_B/dI_D = 1/(g_m + g_ds) = 1/40 μS = 25 kΩ。

method.method_draft: From the image connection set V_GS = V_B and V_DS = V_B. At the specified bias, V_B = 2 V and V_TN = 1 V, so the device is on and in saturation.
